pipeline.algorithm: SHA-256(namespace + ':' + hand_id); first 64 bits big-endian modulo 10000
pipeline.state_management: stateless: per-hand assignments are never persisted and are recomputed from hand_id

training.validation: VALIDATION selects hierarchy shrinkage, continuous models, and capped revealed-card residual scales

methodology.node_identity: Structural preflop context; sizing and stack are continuous and not node identity.
methodology.continuous: Only pre-decision observables: remaining/effective stack and facing price. Own chosen raise size is excluded to prevent target leakage.
methodology.policy169: Theory-informed 169 prior plus weak revealed-card residual selected on VALIDATION, then IPF calibrated to TRAIN-only node marginals.
methodology.runtime_continuous_policy: Continuous stack/facing-price response models are stored for marginal P(Action|context) use, but are NOT applied to the 169 range-composition policy: final VALIDATION showed that per-combo continuous recalibration worsened known-hand log-loss. Embedded policies therefore remain static per structural node in v4.
methodology.revealed_cards: TRAIN only; residual application capped to <=0.5 and retained only with >=0.25% relative VALIDATION log-loss gain because revealed hands are selection-biased.

incremental_update.marginal_update: full-weight additive evidence with historical posterior carry-forward mass old_n+40
incremental_update.policy169_update: FROZEN from v4; no IPF shift accepted because historical revealed-hand non-regression was worse when shifted
